entries.zh: 认清自己的本分；自省改过
entries.en: to know oneself; to know one's own place (and mend one's ways)
entries.notes: 西语栏「mendando」当为「emendando」（改正），与汉字「認本分」相合，然原稿字面受损。

entries.en: mind, spirit; to know another's inmost mind
entries.notes: 西语栏「conocer para con, saberla」晦涩难断，释义依汉字「心神」与 M 栏出；R 栏作 sin sin 与「神」音不合。

entries.en: to know each other, to be acquainted

entries.zh: 面熟；看着眼熟（相识而未深交）
entries.en: to look familiar, to know by sight
entries.notes: M 栏「bin seg hoe bin」多出音节，R 栏「zin」与「熟」音不合，今依汉字「面熟」出释。

entries.zh: 识察过失；看出毛病（汉字栏残损，作「掠…病」）
entries.en: to recognize faults, to spot a failing
entries.notes: 汉字栏首末二字仅存疑似候选（掠/扐、獎/漿），M 栏 T99 污损、R 栏与汉字音不合，仅西语「conocer las faltas」可据。

entries.zh: 被人看破心思；露出恶棍本相
entries.en: to be seen through; to be exposed as a rogue
entries.notes: 第三字据 R 栏「ni」定为「爾」（M 栏作「li」则为「離」），西语「quiere ser gran bellaco」与前半「conocerse」当分读。

entries.en: to know, to recognize
to know someone's inmost intentions; to fathom a heart
to meet, to see each other face to face
to admit one's mistake, to own that one was wrong
to have seen little, to be shallow in experience
〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅「識」可辨，后二字候选（任/仩、乂/久）与 R 栏「chy i gien」皆不合；据 M 栏「bat y cu」或为「識伊久」（识得已久），未敢定。

entries.en: experienced in the world, versed in affairs
familiar with matters, well versed in affairs
well known, of great repute
entries.notes: 汉字确为「影大」（M、R 两栏一致），「影」当指名声、影响，故释为名声大，然此用法罕见。

entries.en: outstanding, distinguished and held in honour
to conquer (a kingdom) by expedition; to campaign against
to smite, to subjugate by force of arms
to attack and subdue a kingdom (lit. "beat the realm")
to set out on a campaign, to march forth to war
to wage a punitive expedition, to conquer
